title: Resources / Emoji
slide_intent: Provide a bounded vocabulary of familiar symbols because notification tone depends on small expressive choices.
strategic_value: A shared emoji selection can help Duolingo messages feel related without prescribing identical wording.
demonstration: A manually selected emoji grid sits beside an explanation of its relevance to notifications. Glyph appearance comes from the capture environment.
practical_value: Use an approved selection as a starting point while checking context and platform rendering.

content_islands.name: Selection rationale
content_islands.spec: Keep the heading and explanation in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Emoji grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange the source glyphs in rows on a pale panel at right, retaining the source duplicates.

reference_purposes.Application: The source presents emoji selected as relevant to Duolingo notifications and acceptable for its branding.

ingredient.name: Notification emoji
ingredient.role: Add recognizable emotional or topical cues to short messages.
ingredient.application: Choose from the supplied selection while checking message context.
ingredient.scope: Historical guideline selection; rendered glyph appearance is platform-dependent, not proprietary Duolingo illustration.
